teaser.en: When palm-wine tappers climb down a coconut palm, the gourd hanging at their side once grew on this vine.
teaser.sw: Wagemaji wa tembo wanaposhuka kutoka kwenye mnazi, kibuyu kinachoning'inia ubavuni mwao kiliwahi kuota kwenye mtambaa huu.
teaser.dg: Ajema achitserera kula dzulu ya mnazi, buru rinarogbwadzika kanda-kanda yao kala rinamera kpwenye mmea huno.

summary.en: *Mchiburu* is the bottle gourd or calabash, a climbing vine grown on farms. Its young fruits are cooked, and its dried shells become containers, including the gourd used to bring palm wine down from the tree.
summary.sw: *Mchiburu* ni mung'unye au kibuyu, mtambaa unaopanda unaolimwa mashambani. Matunda yake machanga hupikwa, na maganda yake yaliyokauka hugeuzwa kuwa vyombo, kikiwemo kibuyu kinachotumika kushusha tembo kutoka mtini.
summary.dg: *Mchiburu* (kpwa Chingereza *bottle gourd* au *calabash*) ni mmea unaokpwera, unaorimwa minda. Matundage maitsi nkujitwa, na mabebe makavu nkugaluka vyombo, phamwenga na buru ambaro ajema nkurihumira kuhala uchi kula dzulu ya muhi.

about.en: *Mchiburu* is a vigorous climbing or trailing vine with soft, hairy, rounded leaves and large white flowers that open in the evening. The fruits vary a great deal in shape, from round to bottle-shaped or long and curved. Young fruits are pale green and tender; left on the vine, they dry into a hard, light, woody shell.
about.sw: *Mchiburu* ni mtambaa unaokua kwa nguvu, unaopanda au kutambaa ardhini, wenye majani laini ya mviringo yenye vinyweleo na maua makubwa meupe yanayochanua jioni. Matunda yake hutofautiana sana kwa umbo, kuanzia ya mviringo hadi yenye umbo la chupa au marefu yaliyopinda. Matunda machanga ni ya kijani hafifu na laini; yakiachwa kwenye mtambaa, hukauka na kuwa ganda gumu, jepesi, kama mti.
about.dg: *Mchiburu* ni mmea wenye nguvu unaokpwera au unaoambala photsi. Una makodza laini, genye nyere na ga mviringo, na maruwa makulu mereru ganayovugula dziloni. Matundage gana maumbo tafwauti sana: ga mviringo, ga umbo dza ra tupa, au marefu na ganayomyoka. Matunda maitsi ni ga chijani ngushu-ngushu na ni laini; gachirichwa kpwenye mmea, ganauma na kukala mabebe genye ufu, maphepheya dza nyama za muhi.

where.en: It is grown on farms, where it is left to sprawl or climb over supports.
where.sw: Hulimwa mashambani, ambapo huachwa kutanda ardhini au kupanda juu ya viegemezo.
where.dg: Nkurimwa minda, ambapho nkurichwa uambale photsi au ukpwere dzulu ya mihi au vitu vyanjina vya kuugbwiriza.

uses.en:
Young fruits are cooked as a vegetable. Dried shells are hollowed out and used as containers.

One such container has its own Digo name: *para* is the gourd that palm-wine tappers use to bring palm wine down from the tree.
uses.sw:
Matunda machanga hupikwa kama mboga. Maganda yaliyokauka hutobolewa ndani na kutumika kama vyombo.

Chombo kimoja kama hicho kina jina lake maalum la Kidigo: *para* ni kibuyu ambacho wagemaji wa tembo hutumia kushusha tembo kutoka mtini.
uses.dg:
Matunda maitsi nkujitwa dza mboga. Mabebe makavu nkuuswa vya ndani na nkuhumirwa dza vyombo.

Chombo chimwenga cha aina hino china dzinare ra Chidigo: *para* ni buru ambaro ajema nkurihumira kuhala uchi kula dzulu ya muhi hadi photsi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mchiburu*. Swahili calls it *mung'unye* or *kibuyu*. In English it is bottle gourd or calabash.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mchiburu*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mung'unye* au *kibuyu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *bottle gourd* au *calabash*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mchiburu*. Chiswahili chinauiha *mung'unye* au *kibuyu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *bottle gourd* au *calabash*.

reason.en: The palm whose wine is carried down in gourds
reason.sw: Mnazi, ambao tembo yake hushushwa ndani ya vibuyu
reason.dg: Mnazi; uchiwe nkuhalwa photsi kpwa maburu.

reason.en: Another plant whose hollow parts hold liquids
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine ambao sehemu zake zenye uwazi ndani hubeba vimiminika
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina ambao seemuze zenye pango nkuikpwa vinwadzi.

definition.en: A gourd for storing seeds, milk, flour and so on.
definition.sw: Kibuyu cha kuhifadhia mbegu, maziwa, unga na kadhalika.
definition.dg: Buru ra kuikira tembe, maziya, unga na vitu vyanjina.

definition.en: A special gourd used to measure palm wine.
definition.dg: Buru ra mbidzo rinarohumirwa kupima uchi.

definition.en: A traditional drinking cup made from a gourd, usually for palm wine.
definition.sw: Kikombe cha jadi cha kunywea kilichotengenezwa kwa kibuyu, kwa kawaida cha tembo.
definition.dg: Chikombe cha chienyeji cha kunwera, chinachohendwa kula buru, kpwa kawaida kpwa kunwera uchi.

definition.en: A gourd a tapper uses to bring palm wine down from a coconut palm.
definition.sw: Kibuyu ambacho mgemaji hutumia kushusha tembo kutoka kwenye mnazi.
definition.dg: Buru ambaro mjema nkurihumira kuhala uchi kula dzulu ya mnazi hadi photsi.

definition.en: A kind of bottle gourd healers (aganga) use to store and display medicine.
definition.sw: Aina ya kibuyu ambacho waganga (aganga) hutumia kuhifadhia na kuonyeshea dawa.
definition.dg: Aina ya buru ambaro aganga nkurihumira kuikira na kuonyesa dawa.
